instructions: At the summit beside the crater entrance, break the cracked wall near the owl.
Climb the vines to bypass the gate guard, follow the right-hand wall to the eastern dead end, bomb the boulder and crawl inside.
Follow the shore to the southeast corner, near the trees, and blast the cracked cliff wall.
Enter the lower crater from Darunia's room in Goron City; follow the shore and hammer the two rock piles blocking the passage.

requires: Bombs; access across the Haunted Wasteland or Requiem of Spirit
instructions: North of the oasis, bomb the cracked wall between the palm trees.

requires: Golden Gauntlets from the castle's Shadow Trial
instructions: Take the dead-end path to the right outside the castle and lift the black pillar with the Golden Gauntlets.
